desc: To commemorate Ruger's diamond anniversary as an American firearms manufacturer, Ruger is offering a special edition of the Ruger SR1911. This pistol features an attractive, finely detailed, laser-engraved slide that commemorates Ruger's 75th Anniversary and salutes their pride in American craftsmanship. The custom grip panels feature detailed scrollwork to match the engraved slide. The Anniversary SR1911 will be produced in very limited quantities during 2024 and will be identifiable by a special ''R75'' serial number prefix. Each pistol ships in a specially marked 75th Anniversary lockable case with one 7-round and one 8-round stainless steel magazine.
